warning.titlePre: Land Rover Discovery SDV6 Timing Chain & Crankshaft Bearing Wear
paragraphs: If your Discovery is a D3 or D4 model with the SDV6 diesel V6 — that's the 3.0-litre unit fitted from 2004 to 2016 — timing chain tensioner wear, injector seal leaks and crankshaft bearing failure risk are well-documented patterns on this engine family, backed by multiple technical service bulletins and specialist sources.
We replace timing chain components, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every SDV6 rebuild.
warning.source: Source: widely documented, multiple TSBs and specialist sources (per G-BRF Land Rover). SDV6 confirmed as affected; TDV6 shares the same pattern; other Discovery variants with different engine families are not affected by this specific issue
